chronology.all_intervals: half-open UTC; requested calendars are policy choices, not claims of data availability
chronology.embargo_rule: 28d between fitting/calibration and scored validation blocks, plus any larger registered actual feature/label span; no later-fold training on earlier validation futures
chronology.historic_contamination: unknown; all historical periods are development evidence, never an untouched final holdout
chronology.purging: exclude origins whose label endpoint reaches or crosses the next partition; nominal max horizon 28d. Fit transforms and calibration on their own earlier permitted partition only.

coverage.historical_plane: historical-reconstruction; unknown first-seen/revision times explicitly unknown
coverage.known_only: Binance Vision BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT monthly 1h USD-M archives: 81 verified ZIPs and 59160 ordered rows per instrument; no missing or duplicate hours in the observed interval. Original release/revision timestamps unknown.
coverage.minimum_complete_fraction: 0.99 per instrument/horizon, with all exclusions and denominator reported; no forward fill of labels; no claims below threshold
coverage.archive_observation_limit: Archive content was inspected for schema and coverage only. Candle time is not first-seen time; no historical PIT or final-range independence follows.

current_gates.scope_of_completion: Frozen bounded historical-reconstruction policy and future final reservation; no live/PIT source, fitting, final-label access, or predictive result admitted.

evaluation.baseline_selection: strongest MAE baseline selected only on development folds; freeze its parameters before calibration/test
baselines: ridge AR with lag counts 1 and 24, regularization fixed 1.0, training-only standardization; no search
evaluation.calibration: if supported: nominal80% and95% intervals; absolute coverage error <=0.05 and <=0.03 respectively; report block-bootstrap coverage CI and width. Each direction reliability bin needs >=30 independent effective blocks; otherwise not qualified. No fabricated probabilities or forced distribution adapters.
evaluation.long_horizon_delay: 40 independent 28d blocks require at least1120d of suitable forward labels, longer with gaps/dependence; final reservation intentionally spans years. Earlier results are provisional.
evaluation.meaningful_margin: at least 0.02 relative MAE improvement; lower simultaneous 95% confidence bound must exceed 0.02, not merely zero
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm control familywise alpha0.05 across all declared horizon claims and <=8 attempted candidate configurations; include failed trials and interventions; final aggregate is confirmatory only after all required horizon/sample gates
evaluation.primary: equal-weight mean across registered horizons of per-horizon MAE skill on log returns vs strongest registered baseline; per-horizon claims also required
evaluation.sample_rule: required blocks are minimum feasibility floors, not a demonstrated power calculation; dependence may reduce eligibility further. No significance/skill claim until confidence and margin gates pass.
secondary: direction balanced accuracy with zero-tie accounting
pinball loss/CRPS only for genuinely supported predictive distributions
Brier/log score only with supported calibrated direction probabilities
economic diagnostic: fixed hypothetical exposure with documented fees/funding/spread/slippage; no execution or profitability inference
evaluation.stop: 8 total attempted trial/configuration slots including failures; no outcome-driven early stopping, repeated holdout peeking or adaptive final thresholds. Budget exhaustion is a stop, not success.
evaluation.uncertainty: paired chronological moving-block bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed42; synchronized blocks across venues/assets; block length at least max(horizon, observed dependence span) and never pool venue counts as independence

final_holdout.access: no research or early-job final-label access. Only future separately qualified evaluator may receive a specific grant; PI01 adds no such grant.
final_holdout.contamination_status: future at registration; no market data fetched in this task; any later access must be audited; pretraining knowledge not assumed clean
final_holdout.if_contaminated: invalidate confirmatory claim, preserve access record, register a later genuinely future reservation before further evaluation; never erase or reset evidence
final_holdout.origin_rule: base and endpoint fully in reserved interval, label mature before scoring
final_holdout.reporting: until gates mature, exploratory/forward monitoring only; no automatic claim of predictive improvement
final_holdout.selection: future-only labels not yet existing at registration; no inspected historical independence inferred

origin_target.cross_asset_rule: common forecast-origin cutoffs; BTC and ETH venues are dependent, not four independent samples
origin_target.information_cutoff: actual issued_at, common across venues/assets for the origin; observations and revisions available by this time only
origin_target.issued_at: t+60s; skip if finalized P(t) was not observed by cutoff; endpoint must remain strictly after issuance
origin_target.label_maturity: endpoint candle finalized and actually received; score only after endpoint+60s and observed finality. Unknown historical release time remains unknown, never backdated. Missing/nonpositive prices or gaps invalidate label.
origin_target.reference_grid: UTC hourly candle end t; finalized last-trade close P(t), no mark/index substitution
secondary_targets: sign(log_return), with zero separate and no artificial tie wins
origin_target.target: log(P(t+h)/P(t)); nominal h measured from reference close t, not issuance; record both timestamps
